purpose: Software developer-related roles with 1-3 years experience, posted within SEEK's Last 30 days filter; separate Brisbane, Australia-wide and Remote search samples.
method: Live rendered SEEK search pages and full advertisement descriptions. Selected Last 30 days in the UI (URL daterange=31) and Remote work arrangement (URL /remote). Convenience sample in displayed search order, not a random sample or vacancy census. Early cached search-engine/withdrawn results excluded.

definitions.E: Developer or hands-on software-delivery/SRE ad with an explicit numerical experience requirement or alternative compatible with some point in 1-3 years. Includes 1+, 2+, 3+ lower bounds. This is not confirmation that an applicant meets all requirements.
definitions.J: Explicit junior, graduate, associate, early-career or mixed-level opening including juniors, but no numerical professional-experience requirement establishing a 1-3-year threshold.
definitions.B: Wider advertised range overlaps 1-3 years (e.g. 2-4, 2-5, 3-8). Excluded from the main E skill denominator.
definitions.X: Not confirmed for the target: higher experience, unquantified professional/senior requirements, adjacent non-development work or irrelevant keyword expansion. No assumption that every X ad demands more than three years.

searchSources.use: 97 distinct ads; supplemented with broad software-developer results to 100
Checked; added no new distinct IDs
Expanded remote sample to 100 distinct ads

codingRules: One mention per ad per skill family; duties, requirements, desirable skills and listed alternatives all count.
Skills were tagged from full rendered descriptions with synonym patterns and checked for relevance; not weighted by mandatory vs desirable.
React combines React and Next.js; JavaScript and TypeScript are combined; C# and .NET are combined.
SQL includes named relational engines; DataStore is broader and includes generic databases and MongoDB.
AI includes coding tools, AI-enabled delivery and interest/exposure; generic company-only AI boilerplate excluded for Google Payments ID 95271703.
NamedCloud is the union of AWS, Azure and GCP mentions, not a sum.
No attached position descriptions were fetched; absence of a tag does not prove absence of a requirement.
Duplicate job IDs are collapsed in Distinct totals. Separate IDs for the same campaign can remain: Sensei IDs 94959991 and 94960073 are near-identical.

Virgin Australia 95220494 excluded as primarily production support after checking duties, despite its developer-sounding title. Axon and Google SRE ads retained because explicit software development is a core duty.
